candidate.answerReason: The original sum is 85. Every possible remaining sum lies from 66 through 70, whose only multiple of 4 is 68. Therefore the erased number is 85−68=17.

methods.label: Find the possible remaining sum
methods.explanation:
First find the sum before any number is erased:
\[
15+16+17+18+19=85.
\]
Erasing the largest number leaves \(85-19=66\), and erasing the smallest leaves \(85-15=70\). Thus every possible remaining sum is between \(66\) and \(70\), inclusive.

Consecutive multiples of \(4\) around this range are
\[
4\times16=64,\qquad4\times17=68,\qquad4\times18=72.
\]
Only \(68\) lies in the required range, so the erased number must be \(85-68=17\). This number is on the list, and erasing it does leave the multiple \(68\). Therefore the answer is \(\boxed{17}\), choice \(\text{C}\).
